ruleset.name: main-guard
ruleset.$bypassNote: Rulesets canon, owner 2026-09-24: the bypass list is EMPTY. Nobody deletes or force-pushes main with a token; a deliberate history rewrite means the owner disables this ruleset in the UI first, then re-enables it. The dependabot-auto-merge-gate ruleset (required_status_checks) is a DIFFERENT ruleset and keeps its admin always-bypass, because the belt's direct pushes to main depend on it.
ruleset.$noRequiredStatusChecksNote: UMB-048 item 4's caveat, encoded here rather than only in prose: this ruleset deliberately carries NO required_status_checks rule. The red-fix (.github commit da15148) gates every skeleton CI step — and the whole CodeQL job — on hashFiles(<script>) != '', so a step can legitimately SKIP rather than run on a freshly scaffolded repo with no scripts/ yet. A required-status-check ruleset binds on the JOB's own name (e.g. 'gate', 'all-green'), which still reports success when every step inside it skips — so naming a job here would be SAFE by that same property. The caveat is real anyway: a required check must name a job that ALWAYS EXISTS in the workflow run (never a job gated out entirely by an `if:` at the job level, e.g. CodeQL's `analyze` job) or the ruleset blocks every push forever waiting for a check that never reports. Where a room DOES want required checks, name 'gate'/'all-green' (job-level `if:` is absent, only its STEPS are hashFiles-gated) — never 'analyze (javascript)' from codeql.yml until that room ships real JS/TS source.

$gateRulesetNote: The dependabot-auto-merge-gate ruleset (required_status_checks, admin bypass -- SWEEP-MARKS.md's row) is NOT applied by new-repo.mjs; it is created per room by hand and judged by skeleton-check.mjs --settings. Its canon since 2026-09-25 (owner AR-75 (3)): every required check names its source, the GitHub Actions app, integration_id 15368 (scripts/lib/ruleset-match.mjs GATE_CHECK_SOURCE) -- never 'any source'. scripts/gate-check-source.mjs prepares the full PUT body per repo and applies one repo per run. Recorded here so a later settings pass cannot read the gate as canon-less and put 'any source' back.

tagRuleset.name: tag-immutable
tagRuleset.$note: Rulesets canon, owner 2026-09-24: a published tag cannot be moved, deleted or force-pushed by anyone; CREATING a tag stays free (the release flow pushes new tags with --follow-tags). The ruleset half of the immutable-releases direction. Kolwen carried this ruleset first (2026-09-05).
